newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Most Swedes critical of EU membership - poll.
newsitem.headline: Most Swedes critical of EU membership - poll.

text.p: Nearly a half of Swedes believe Sweden has lost out from membership of the European Union and that the country should leave the EU, a poll showed on Monday.
The survey was commissioned by the European Commission and carried out simultaneously in all EU countries. The Swedish polling and analysis was carried out by opinion institute TEMO.

Only four out of ten Swedes thought the country should stay in the EU. Just one in three was in favour of the EU project as a whole. The agency gave details only for Sweden, but said dissatisfaction was higher than in other EU states.
Swedes lack commitment, conviction and enthusiasm for European cooperation, TEMO said in its analysis.
"Few seem happy with membership thus far. In that respect, we differ widely from the rest of Europe," the institute said.
